steps.text: Artifacts faceup on their numbered spaces{n}

byPlayers.5: , with the 5 Adventuring Party ones: shuffle all 12 facedown, box 2 at random, stack equal values with the original gold one on top
byPlayers.6: , with the 5 Adventuring Party ones (12 in all); stack equal values with the original gold one on top

steps.note: Ape Lords boards: 33-point artifact replaces the 30; Spider's Lair: 8-point replaces the 7. Adventuring Party: an artifact with no space of its value goes on the closest one, higher value on top

steps.text: Shuffle Major and Minor Secrets separately; one on each Major space, two in each Minor room; box extras unseen
Shuffle Major Secrets, one on each Major space (box extras unseen); mix the Adventuring Party Minor Secrets into the original ones and keep them all facedown in the Bank, none on the board
Market items: 2 Master Keys, 2 Backpacks, 3 Crowns (10, 9, 8){x}
Market Board beside the board: add the Adventuring Party Backpack, Crown and Master Key and 3 Invisibility Cloaks to the Market items
Optional: Market Board beside the board with 2 Invisibility Cloaks among the Market items
3 Monkey Idols on the Monkey Shrine; 1 Mastery token per player near the top left
Gold tokens (1 and 5) as the Bank
Add the Adventuring Party Gold to the Bank
Dragon marker on space {n} of the Rage Track
Side board against the bottom edge of the board; Dragon marker (or the Hexavultus boss marker) on the first space of its Rage Track
24 black dragon cubes in the Dragon Bag
Reserve: Goblin, Mercenary, Explore and Secret Tome piles
Add the 4 extra Mercenary, Explore and Secret Tome cards to the Reserve piles
Shuffle the Dungeon Deck; deal 6 faceup as the Dungeon Row, replacing any with Dragon Attack
steps.note: Shuffle in the 35 Sunken Treasures, 40 Mummy's Curse and/or 35 Adventuring Party cards first if used

steps.text: Market Board beside the board; all Market items go on it
Market Board beside the board; all Market items go on it
2 SCUBA tokens with the Market items
Goldfish card in the Reserve next to the Goblin
Mix the new Major and Minor Secrets in before placing secrets; box extras unseen
2 Ankhs with the Market items; 24 Curse tokens in the Bank
Mix the new Major and Minor Secrets (Mummy's Treasure, Chalice, Scarabs) in; box extras unseen
Mummy marker on its start zone space; Mummy card in the Reserve; pyramid die by the board; Supreme Monkey Idol on its space
3 mining bonus tokens on their spaces below the Clank! area (the entrance flag is on the right)
Shuffle the 12 Web tokens facedown, one on each web space
2 Time Winders with the Market items
2 Time Winders with the Market items
Bronze Guardian: one cog, one wrench, one banana faceup; the other 15 ape-aratus tokens shuffled, one on each marked tunnel
9 gear tokens in their spaces, random orientation (3- and 4-sided ones in random spots), then faceup
Deal 3 secret ape-aratus tokens to each player; box the rest unseen
8 RNG tokens shuffled facedown: one on each marked Rage Track space, the other 4 stacked on the space above
Each player: 30 Clank! cubes and a pawn of one color
10-card deck: 6 Burgle, 2 Stumble, 1 Cautious Advance, 1 Skillful Move; shuffle and draw 5
Players 5 and 6: cubes and pawns of the two new colors and the two extra 10-card starting decks
Optional: everyone plays a character instead, with its board, its own 10-card starting deck and its tokens
steps.note: Characters play only against other characters, never against regular starting decks

steps.text: Pawns just outside the dungeon at the top of the board
The sneakiest player goes first; clockwise
Starting Clank! in the Clank! Area by seat: 3, 2, 1, 0
Players 5 and 6 add no Clank!; player 5 takes 1 Gold, player 6 takes 2 Gold
